name: Natalia
source:
The Yandere Spy
The most dangerous yandere among the three.
Just talking to another girl is enough for her to aim a gun at the protagonist.
She exudes a seductive aura and is the older-sister type—though she’s the same age as the protagonist.
After the protagonist discovers her secret as a spy, she becomes obsessed with ensuring he doesn’t tell anyone.
Though her feelings for the protagonist grow over time, her deep-seated secrets weigh heavily on her interactions with others.
[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250306211017/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.yanderehalem]Google Play[/url]]
